Priya (docs): Quick flag - migration page still has scattered snippets using `tool.call` and an old response envelope. SDK tests are failing. Can someone grab the canonical shape?
Cole (eng): The runtime now returns an envelope: { status: 'ok'|'error', payload: { ... } , error?: { code, message } }. For success, payload is required.
Vera (devex): I'll update JS and Python examples to `client.invoke`/`invoke_action`. Priya, can you add a short guardrail about not relying on field ordering inside payloads?
Priya (docs): Yep. Also CI linkcheck found a broken anchor linking to `#response-format`  heading changed. Please confirm new anchor.
ci-bot: link-check(https://docs.redwood.ai/migrate#response-format) -> 404. Suggest anchor: #response-envelope--guardrails
Cole (eng): Confirmed. Also recommend calling out: treat `error` as canonical failure indicator and do not infer errors from missing payload fields.
Vera (devex): Adding examples: JS snippet with `invoke({operation:{name:'files.upload', args:{}}})` and Python parity. Will push small PR.
Priya (docs): Sweet. I'll update the JSON schema block to mark `payload` required when status=='ok' and add the guardrail note + anchor fix. Opening PR shortly.
Vera (devex): PR #1402 opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1402  includes snippets, schema, and anchor fix. Requesting Cole for a quick review.
Cole (eng): Reviewing now. Tiny nit on wording, suggest "do not treat missing payload fields as implicit failure".
Priya (docs): Updated wording and force-pushed. CI requeued.
ci-bot: PR #1402  ci/linkcheck  passed.
Vera (devex): Merged. Thanks all. I'll run an audit script to find other `tool.call` references and post results here.
Priya (docs): Great, thanks. If anyone sees other obsolete snippets in examples or SDK docs, drop them in this thread and I'll batch follow-ups.
